Good evening, Rohan ji. Main Ananya bol rahi hoon Bluepoint Homes se. Aapne 99acres par Bluepoint Skyline Residences, Kharadi ke liye enquiry ki thi, toh usi ke baare mein baat karni thi. Kya yeh do minute baat karne ke liye sahi time hai?
Dekho, maine already flat le liya hai. Mujhe dobara call mat karna, mera number apni list se hata do.
I am so sorry for the disturbance, Rohan ji. Main abhi aapka number list se hata deti hoon taaki aapko dobara call na aaye. Goodbye.

outcome.comment: The lead explicitly asked to be removed from the list and not called again.

objections_raised.comment: None, lead already purchased a flat.

language_used.comment: Conversation was in a mix of Hindi and English.

closer_summary.value: Rohan mentioned he has already purchased a flat and requested to be removed from the calling list. The agent acknowledged the request and ended the call.

testResultSummary: PASS: The agent responded to the opt-out with a short apology, confirmed removal from the list, made no further pitch or questions, and called end_call in the same turn. No forbidden functions were called.
